name: pi-tool-display
notes: Forked from MasuRii/pi-tool-display; local bashLivePreviewMode (tail live preview for running bash commands) feature intentionally diverges from upstream. The fork also adds a kind:'bash' tool-display adapter so pi-sandbox's decorated bash tool renders natively (renderBashDisplayResult extracted in tool-overrides.ts, serving both the built-in override path and the adapter; the promptGuidelines-copying registration-test assertions match upstream createBuiltinToolDisplay behavior), plus type-publishing build (rollup.dts.config.mjs, exports types -> dist/public.d.ts via prepack). 2026-09-19: tail/head preview unified — upstream formatTruncationHint gained an optional label param and buildPreviewText an optional take:'head'|'tail' param (defaults keep upstream behavior byte-stable); the fork-only formatEarlierLinesHint/buildTailPreviewText copies were removed and the unreachable empty-lines branch dropped. 2026-09-27: added fork-only bashOutputMode:'auto' (live tail preview while running, line-count summary after success; errors keep opencode rendering) in fork-only src/bash-auto-mode.ts (resolveBashAutoOutputMode normalizer). Upstream seams: one import of that module in tool-overrides.ts, one normalization call at the top of the fork-owned renderBashDisplayResult before the partial/error branches, types.ts BASH_OUTPUT_MODES gains 'auto', config-modal.ts bashOutputMode values+inspectorOptions and bashCollapsedLines summary/advanced wording, README mode/config rows + live-preview paragraph. Fork-only tests/bash-auto-mode.test.ts covers it (re-audit all of these after each sync). Same change restored 4 pre-existing whitespace-only README table-separator rows to upstream bytes, so raw numstat equals -w for every touched upstream file. Deliberate non-change: package-lock.json keeps upstream bytes at the upstream version 0.5.0 across fork releases — it is unconsumed in this pnpm monorepo and npm excludes it from tarballs; do not hand-edit it, keep upstream bytes on syncs.
